note: Battery tab settings for this profile. No chemistry is set: the owner's 2019 1.8 has the 56-cell lithium-ion pack (docs/02 C5, confirmed by the owner), but the profile covers several years and engines, which may carry a NiMH pack instead; the app tells the type from the cell voltages, and the owner can set it in Settings. The limits are HybridGuard guide values (the same as HybridMaster's for the lithium-ion pack), not Toyota specifications: tune them in Settings as the owner's logs show what is normal. Balance and spread are judged at rest (|HV current| below restCurrentA). The NiMH limits apply to block voltages (several cells in series, about 14-16 V each), as NiMH packs usually report them.
